polygons.name: Lacustrine sand
polygons.description: Adironack sheet: Generally quartz sand, well sorted, stratified, usually deposited in proglacial lakes, but may have been deposited on remnant ice and/or may be gradational with outwash, generally a near-shore deposit or near a sand source, permeable, thickness variable (2-20 meters). Niagara, Finge
